title: Balochistan Agricultural Produce Markets Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Agricultural Produce Markets Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XI OF 2004
ACT XI OF 2004
BALOCHISTAN
AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
2004
An Act further to
amend the Balochistan Agriculture Markets Act, 1991 (1 of 1991)
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th August, 2004]
No. PAB/:Legis:V(19)/2004,
dated 30-8-2004.--The Balochistan Agricultural ,Produce Markets (Amendment)
Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 24th
August, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan Agriculture
Produce Markets (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

No. PAB/:Legis:V(19)/2004,
dated 30-8-2004.--The Balochistan Agricultural ,Produce Markets (Amendment)
Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 24th
August, 2004 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Act I of 1991.---In the Balochistan Agriculture Produce Markets Act, 1991,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 2; in clause (g), for the
word "Deputy Commissioner" appearing twice the words "Director
of Agriculture (Economics and Marketing)" shall be substituted twice.
